violation: Interactive elements do not support keyboard navigation
remediation: Ensure interactive elements support full keyboard navigation
rationale: Keyboard-only users are unable to interact with the application

violation: Interactive elements do not have visible focus indicators
remediation: Ensure focus-visible styles are applied to all interactive elements
rationale: Without focus indicators, keyboard users lose track of navigation

violation: Transitions or animations are not reduced for users with prefers-reduced-motion
remediation: Detect prefers-reduced-motion via media query and reduce or disable animations
rationale: Motion-sensitive users may experience discomfort or nausea with excessive animations

violation: Buttons and links do not provide visual feedback on hover/focus
remediation: Ensure all buttons and links provide feedback on hover/focus (e.g., change color or background)
rationale: Without hover/focus states, users cannot easily understand interactable elements

violation: Forms and actions auto-submit without warning
remediation: Provide clear user notifications or cancel options for auto-submitting actions or timeouts
rationale: Unexpected timeouts or submissions can confuse or frustrate users

violation: Tooltips appear without a way to dismiss them
remediation: Ensure tooltips can be dismissed via keyboard or mouse
rationale: Tooltips that cannot be dismissed may block content for users with disabilities

violation: Error messages are not easily visible or accessible
affected_users: users with screen readers or cognitive impairments
remediation: Provide clear inline error messages associated with form fields
rationale: Users cannot easily identify or correct errors without proper guidance

violation: Interactive elements fail to provide feedback when clicked
remediation: Ensure clickable elements provide immediate feedback (e.g., visual changes or loading indicators)
rationale: Without feedback, users are uncertain if their action has been registered

violation: Multi-step forms do not provide progress indication
remediation: Provide clear progress indicators for multi-step forms
rationale: Lack of progress information can confuse users and lead to abandonment

affected_users: screen reader users and keyboard-only users
remediation: Add a skip navigation link at the top of the page
rationale: Screen reader users and keyboard users waste time navigating the same links repeatedly

violation: Links do not have clear text or context
remediation: Ensure all links have meaningful, descriptive text or aria-labels
rationale: Unclear links cause confusion and prevent users from understanding their purpose

violation: Users cannot adjust or turn off animation speed
affected_users: users with cognitive or motion impairments
remediation: Allow users to adjust or disable animations via settings
rationale: Users with sensitivities may find excessive motion distracting or overwhelming

violation: Modals do not trap focus or provide escape methods
remediation: Ensure modals trap focus within and provide easy escape via escape key or close button
rationale: Users may be trapped in modals, unable to continue navigation or exit

violation: Drag-and-drop interactions are not keyboard or screen reader accessible
remediation: Provide alternative ways to interact with drag-and-drop features (e.g., buttons for each action)
rationale: Without alternatives, drag-and-drop interactions are unusable for many users

violation: Focusable elements are not accessible via keyboard
remediation: Ensure all interactive elements are reachable via keyboard navigation (tabindex)
rationale: Keyboard-only users cannot interact with non-focusable elements

remediation: Use <label> or aria-label to provide accessible names for form controls
rationale: Users cannot understand or interact with form controls without accessible names

violation: State changes are not announced to screen readers
remediation: Use ARIA live regions or other mechanisms to announce state changes dynamically
rationale: State changes such as selections or updates must be communicated for screen reader users
